errors.text: The predicted homogeneous FCC matrix conflicts with the target mixed structure of approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC.
The stated SPS heating rate of 100°C/min disagrees with the target condition of 50°C/min, while key milling conditions of 400 rpm and a 20:1 ball-to-powder ratio are omitted.
The proposed falsification logic is inverted: hardness loss at 1150°C from grain growth would support the claimed upper-temperature boundary rather than falsify the hypothesis.

Low-load hardness plus XRD alone does not isolate Hall-Petch strengthening from precipitation hardening; matched grain-size and phase-fraction controls or direct precipitate characterization are required.

The cited evidence concerns compositionally different refractory HEAs and does not substantiate a six-hour BCC-to-FCC transition, the claimed HCP behavior, or the numerical process boundaries in CoCrFeNiTi.
